title: Truck Town
tagline: Drive three kinds of truck around a tiny town.
blurb: You pick a minivan, a semi with a trailer, or a tow truck, then drive around a small town with ramps and a turbo button. I keep it here because it is the quickest way I know to feel real vehicle physics in a browser.
desc: Truck Town, the Godot Engine vehicle-physics demo: drive a minivan, a semi-truck, or a tow truck around a low-poly town. Hosted on kaleerson.com.
author: the Godot Engine contributors
tags: truck town godot driving trucks vehicle physics
extraCredit: It is a Godot 4 web export, so it needs a browser with WebGL 2 (any recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari). On a phone it steers itself forward: touch the left or right edge to turn and the middle to brake.
